items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, I had a job in the country for Austin and Johnny Henry.

ctx.x: First was Wesley Dunn. Yeah, and second was Blue. Yeah. And third was who? What's the man this? No, ask him who the third corner.

Who was the third corner player? William Padjo. William and Ricard Ellis was the fourth. Oh, huh. And then Willie Edwards was the fifth. George McCullen was the sixth. Albert Du Conger, he was the seventh. Chris Kelly, he was another good corner player. You hear what I'm talking about? And then I played by the fellow with the third. And then Johnny Henry with the third. And then I went with Punch, you see? After Punch quit Jack Carey, where he was taking Jack's whole band. He played with him. Ask him if you…
Did you play with Jack any?
